shortDescription: Play kubernetes YAML file using podman

options.name: annotation
options.description: Add an annotation to the container or pod.

options.name: authfile
options.description: Path of the authentication file. Default is ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/containers/auth.json, which is set using podman login. If the authorization state is not found there, $HOME/.docker/config.json is checked, which is set using docker login. Note - You can also override the default path of the authentication file by setting the REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE environment variable. export REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE=path

options.name: build
options.description: Build images even if they are found in the local storage. It is required to exist subdirectories matching the image names to be build.

options.name: cert_dir
options.description: Use certificates at path (*.crt, *.cert, *.key) to connect to the registry. Default certificates directory is /etc/containers/certs.d. (This option is not available with the remote Podman client)

options.name: configmap
options.description: Use Kubernetes configmap YAML at path to provide a source for environment variable values within the containers of the pod. Note - The configmap option can be used multiple times to pass multiple Kubernetes configmap YAMLs

options.name: context_dir
options.description: Use path as the build context directory for each image. Requires build option be true.

options.name: debug
options.description: Enable debug for the module.

options.name: executable
options.description: Name of executable to run, by default 'podman'

options.name: kube_file
options.description: Path to file with YAML configuration for a Pod.

options.name: kube_file_content
options.description: Content of the kube file.

options.name: log_driver
options.description: Set logging driver for all created containers.

options.name: log_level
options.description: Set logging level for podman calls. Log messages above specified level ("debug"|"info"|"warn"|"error"|"fatal"|"panic") (default "error")

options.name: log_opt
options.description: Logging driver specific options. Set custom logging configuration.

options.name: network
options.description: List of the names of CNI networks the pod should join.

options.name: password
options.description: The username and password to use to authenticate with the registry if required.

options.name: quadlet_dir
options.description: Path to the directory to write quadlet file in. By default, it will be set as C(/etc/containers/systemd/) for root user, C(~/.config/containers/systemd/) for non-root users.

options.name: quadlet_file_mode
options.description: The permissions of the quadlet file. The O(quadlet_file_mode) can be specified as octal numbers or as a symbolic mode (for example, V(u+rwx) or V(u=rw,g=r,o=r)). For octal numbers format, you must either add a leading zero so that Ansible's YAML parser knows it is an octal number (like V(0644) or V(01777)) or quote it (like V('644') or V('1777')) so Ansible receives a string and can do its own conversion from string into number. options.name: quadlet_filename
options.description: Name of quadlet file to write. Must be specified if state is quadlet.

options.name: quadlet_options
options.description: Options for the quadlet file. Provide missing in usual network args options as a list of lines to add.

options.name: quiet
options.description: Hide image pulls logs from output.

options.name: recreate
options.description: If pod already exists, delete it and run the new one.

options.name: seccomp_profile_root
options.description: Directory path for seccomp profiles (default is "/var/lib/kubelet/seccomp"). This option is not available with the remote Podman client

options.name: state
options.description: Start the pod after creating it, or to leave it created only.

options.name: tls_verify
options.description: Require HTTPS and verify certificates when contacting registries (default is true). If explicitly set to true, then TLS verification will be used. If set to false, then TLS verification will not be used. If not specified, TLS verification will be used unless the target registry is listed as an insecure registry in registries.conf.

options.name: username
options.description: The username and password to use to authenticate with the registry if required.

options.name: userns
options.description: Set the user namespace mode for all the containers in a pod. It defaults to the PODMAN_USERNS environment variable. An empty value ("") means user namespaces are disabled.
